package.json:
{
  "name": "inventory-platform",
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "engines": {
    "node": "24.x",
    "npm": "11.x"
  },
  "packageManager": "npm@11.6.2",
  "scripts": {
    "format": "prettier --write .",
    "format:check": "prettier --check .",
    "check:foundation": "node scripts/check-foundation.mjs",
    "validate": "npm run format:check && npm run check:foundation && npm run check:parity && npm run check:redesign && npm run audit:ui && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build",
    "build:shared": "npm run build -w @inventory/design-tokens && npm run build -w @inventory/api-client && node scripts/build-quill-assets.mjs",
    "dev:web": "npm run dev -w @inventory/web",
    "dev:api": "npm run dev -w @inventory/api",
    "dev:mobile": "npm run dev -w @inventory/mobile",
    "dev:desktop": "npm run dev -w @inventory/desktop",
    "lint": "eslint . && npm run check:boundaries",
    "check:boundaries": "depcruise apps packages --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs",
    "typecheck": "npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @inventory/domain -w @inventory/contracts -w @inventory/api-client -w @inventory/api -w @inventory/web -w @inventory/mobile && tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "npm run build:shared && npm run test:tooling && vitest run",
    "test:integration": "npm run build:shared && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts",
    "build": "npm run build -w @inventory/api && npm run build -w @inventory/web",
    "build:mobile": "npm run build -w @inventory/mobile",
    "build:desktop": "npm run build -w @inventory/desktop",
    "test:tooling": "node --test scripts/*.test.mjs",
    "setup": "node scripts/setup.mjs",
    "dev": "node scripts/dev.mjs",
    "start": "npm run dev",
    "android": "npm run android -w @inventory/mobile",
    "ios": "npm run ios -w @inventory/mobile",
    "doctor": "node scripts/doctor.mjs",
    "db:local": "node scripts/local-database.mjs",
    "db:seed:dev": "npm run db:seed:dev -w @inventory/api --",
    "predev:web": "npm run setup",
    "predev:api": "npm run setup",
    "predev:mobile": "npm run setup",
    "predev:desktop": "npm run setup",
    "preandroid": "npm run setup && node scripts/doctor.mjs android",
    "preios": "npm run setup && node scripts/doctor.mjs ios",
    "package:api": "npm run build -w @inventory/api && node scripts/package-api.mjs",
    "test:web:browser": "playwright test",
    "dev:mock:web": "node scripts/dev-mock.mjs web",
    "dev:mock:mobile": "node scripts/dev-mock.mjs mobile",
    "dev:mock:desktop": "node scripts/dev-mock.mjs desktop",
    "db:seed:showcase": "node scripts/seed-showcase.mjs",
    "db:backup": "node scripts/database-backup.mjs",
    "package:desktop:remote": "node scripts/desktop-profile.mjs remote",
    "package:desktop:local": "node scripts/desktop-profile.mjs local-network",
    "db:seed:transactions": "node scripts/seed-transactions.mjs",
    "check:parity": "node scripts/check-parity.mjs",
    "audit:ui": "node scripts/audit-ui.mjs",
    "redesign:inventory": "node scripts/route-coverage.mjs && node scripts/redesign-components.mjs",
    "redesign:baseline": "node scripts/redesign-baseline.mjs && node scripts/redesign-supplement.mjs && node scripts/redesign-performance.mjs",
    "check:docs": "node scripts/check-docs.mjs",
    "check:redesign": "node scripts/route-coverage.mjs --check && npm run check:docs"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@eslint/js": "9.39.5",
    "@playwright/test": "^1.64.1",
    "@testing-library/react": "^16.3.3",
    "@testing-library/user-event": "^14.6.8",
    "@types/express": "^5.0.0",
    "@types/node": "^24.0.0",
    "@types/pg": "^8.15.0",
    "@types/react": "~19.3.0",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.2.0",
    "@types/supertest": "^6.0.0",
    "axe-core": "^4.14.0",
    "dependency-cruiser": "18.6.0",
    "eslint": "9.39.5",
    "eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y": "6.10.2",
    "eslint-plugin-react-hooks": "7.1.1",
    "fake-indexeddb": "6.2.6",
    "globals": "^16.0.0",
    "jsdom": "^29.1.1",
    "prettier": "3.9.10",
    "supertest": "^7.0.0",
    "tsx": "4.23.15",
    "typescript": "6.0.3",
    "typescript-eslint": "8.71.2",
    "vite": "8.3.4",
    "vitest": "5.0.5"
  },
  "workspaces": [
    "apps/*",
    "packages/*"
  ]
}
